chart.modeKd: 💀 Who wins fights: kills per death against easy → hard enemies. Higher line = wins more fights.

chart.modeAim: 🎯 Who aims best: each line keeps its shape but is lifted to the player's aim score (public IvI = accuracy × headshot %). Higher line = better aim, not more wins. Players can swap places between the two views: sharp aim doesn't always win fights, and vehicle / explosive players win without headshots.

tip.adjs: Overall rating from how you do against the ~200 players you fight most, worth more the stronger they are, with a bonus for fast killing and a cut for slow, safe play.
tip.act: How much winning combat you put out: your K/D against the players you fight most, multiplied by how fast you kill.
tip.pvs: Activity that keeps up as enemies get stronger: high when you stay productive even against the fastest-killing players you meet.
tip.rf: How well you stand up to strong players: your K/D against the players you fight most, scaled up by how fast those players kill.
tip.cons: How much of your K/D you keep against the strongest third of your opponents compared with the weakest third: 1.00 means it holds completely, 0.50 means it halves.
tip.apk: Assists per kill in recent Honu sessions: how often you help damage enemies that teammates finish, for each kill of your own.
tip.rkd: Kills ÷ deaths against the ~200 players you fight most, so it reflects real matchups rather than your whole lifetime.
tip.inf: Share of lifetime kills made with infantry weapons (Census weapon stats). Vehicle seats and turrets don't count; MAX suit weapons count as infantry (the MAX share is on hover).
tip.kd: Overall kill/death ratio from Census / Honu.
tip.ownKpm: Your own weapon pace (kills per minute with your weapons).
tip.ivi: Infantry vs Infantry score from Census / Honu.

vehicles.p1: ⚔️ iVi measures infantry skill only. If more than 10% of your lifetime kills come from vehicles (seats, turrets), the share above 10% is subtracted from adjusted iVi; MAX kills above 10% are subtracted the same way, separately. The two add up, with no cap: e.g. 96% vehicle kills → −86%; 45% vehicle + 40% MAX → −65%. Pure infantry is untouched.
